Use-case details / priorities:
- Primary: in-product support assistant to triage user questions, escalate to human when confidence < threshold. 
- Secondary: embeddings for in-app search and reranking of help docs.
- Latency target: <400ms median for single-turn chatbot calls; currently ok during tests but not exercised at scale.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget, wants clear per-1000-token estimate; likely to switch to competitor if unit economics worse by >20%.

Technical notes / preferences:
- Prefers latest open LLM variants (small to medium) to keep costs down. Interested in model routing/fallback to cheaper model for non-critical queries.
- Deployment: public cloud OK, no VPC/enterprise requirement at this stage.
- Security: wants basic audit logging and token access history; SOC2 not required for now.

Next steps / recommended AE playbook:
- Send a 1-page migration/playbook that shows quick wins (enable streaming, increase concurrency in SDK, example batching config). Link to quickstart templates.
- Offer a 2-week usage pulse: we'll monitor token usage & false-positive hallucinations, send weekly summary.
- Offer a short credit to run higher-volume test (remove cost friction).
- Follow-up call scheduled 2026-03-18 (15m) to present playbook and confirm appetite.
